name: Goi ca mai
summary: Gỏi cá mai is thin raw cá mai dressed with lime, fish sauce, and garlic. Vietnam Tourism serves it with rice paper, herbs, and peanuts, and calls the dressing tangy, sweet, and slightly spicy.
